# third_party

- `enet/` - ENet 1.3.x by Lee Salzman, MIT license (see `enet/LICENSE`). Bundled, used by the sync transport.
- `NVSE/` - **not bundled.** Clone xNVSE here: `git clone https://github.com/xNVSE/NVSE third_party/NVSE`.
  Needed only to build `nvcoop.dll`.
- `nvmp/` - **not bundled.** Put your own NV:MP 9.4 client files here to run the NV:MP signature and patcher
  tests. NV:MP is by the NV:MP team (nv-mp.com) and is not redistributed here.
